_what: Hand-authored pipeline INPUT. Not an edit of any pipeline output — src/data/dex.json stays wholly produced by a run, and a re-run against unchanged inputs still reproduces it byte for byte.
_why: Three Mega forms exist in the PokeAPI exports (varieties absol-mega-z, garchomp-mega-z, lucario-mega-z: base stats, sprites, English/Japanese/French form names) but two fields have no upstream source at all — the Champions roster entry and the abilities. This file supplies exactly those two and nothing else. The roster entry is where a form's English label, its types and its roster status come from. Base stats and sprite paths keep coming from PokeAPI for these forms like every other.
_delete_when: An upstream source starts carrying a field below. Delete that entry, re-run the pipeline, and the dataset must come out unchanged. When every entry is gone, delete this file and the two hooks that read it.

megas._source: Types decided by the project owner 2026-09-01. Bulbapedia's Champions page carries no row for this form at all, commented or otherwise, and PokeAPI carries no types for any form.
megas._delete_when: Bulbapedia's Champions page lists Mega Absol Z as a released row.
megas.name: Absol

megas._source: Types copied from Bulbapedia's own commented-out row for this form (single-type Dragon, unlike Mega Garchomp's Dragon/Ground). Corroborated by the ability: Levitate replaces the Ground typing rather than stacking with it.
megas._delete_when: Bulbapedia's Champions page lists Mega Garchomp Z as a released row.
megas.name: Garchomp

megas._source: Types copied from Bulbapedia's own commented-out row for this form, unchanged from Mega Lucario.
megas._delete_when: Bulbapedia's Champions page lists Mega Lucario Z as a released row.
megas.name: Lucario

_added_note: 'added' is set to each species' own version so the assembled form carries no separate version field. Upstream has assigned these forms no version yet — its rows show a placeholder — and the detail panel shows the species version either way, so an empty value would change nothing on screen while putting an empty field in the dataset.
_abilities_note: Rows that pokemon_abilities.csv would carry if PokeAPI had them. Same shape as that file: pokemon_id keyed, each slot naming an ability_id and whether it is hidden.
_new_abilities_note: An ability PokeAPI does not have at all, so it needs the rows abilities.csv, ability_names.csv and ability_flavor_text.csv would carry. The id is far outside the upstream range (max upstream id is 10060) so it can never collide with a real one, and so that its being synthetic is visible at a glance.

abilities._source: Supplied by the project owner 2026-09-01. Absent from every PokeAPI export.
abilities._delete_when: PokeAPI carries this ability; then use its real id.
